reference_solution.boundaries: June extra debt=5*420-2050=50. September external debt paydown=2050-4.5*420=160. June maximum EBITDA decline=420-2050/5=10. Minimum qualifying cash=2200-5*420=100, below the 150 cap.
reference_solution.insufficiency: If qualifying cash is zero, leverage=2200/420=5.238095238... and exceeds 5; if qualifying cash reaches 150, leverage=2050/420<5. Total cash alone cannot identify pass/fail. Section 4 separately conditions effectiveness; signing alone is insufficient.
